description:
What a wallet can borrow against on GONDI right now: the NFTs it
holds in its wallet, stash or vaults and not already in a loan, with
the largest loan offer each can take today (net principal, APR,
duration, origination fee, loan-to-floor and expiry), the one GONDI's
Borrow page shows. NFTs sharing that offer, such as a collection offer
on several of them, come as one opportunity listing them with their
gondi_url (the page where the user borrows) and fundable_count, how
many of them the offer can still fund, one loan each: say "19 Miladies;
one offer can fund 3 of them". limit counts offers, not NFTs. Answers
"what can I borrow against my NFTs?". For the cheapest loan on one
collection, call list_loan_offers with offer_type CollectionOffer,
sort_by APR_BPS and order ASC.

currency.description: Only offers in this principal currency; any if unset.
currency.title: Currency

sort_by.description: PRINCIPAL ranks the most you can borrow first, in USD; APR the cheapest offer first.
sort_by.title: Sort By

wallet.description: The borrower: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

name: list_borrowing_opportunities

BorrowableNft.description: One of the wallet's NFTs an opportunity's offer applies to.
BorrowableNft.title: BorrowableNft

BorrowingOffer.description: The loan offer a borrower can take on the NFT now.

expires_at.description: When the offer stops being takeable.
expires_at.title: Expires At

loan_to_floor_percent.description: The net principal as a share of the collection floor, both in USD; null without a floor or a rate.
loan_to_floor_percent.title: Loan To Floor Percent

net_principal.description: What the borrower receives: the principal the lender can fund now, less the origination fee.
net_principal.title: Net Principal

net_principal_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
net_principal_usd.title: Net Principal Usd

offer_type.description: Made on every NFT of the collection, on this NFT alone, or on a chosen set of NFTs it belongs to.
offer_type.title: Offer Type

BorrowingOffer.title: BorrowingOffer

BorrowingOpportunity.description:
One offer and the wallet's NFTs it is the best offer on: every held NFT
of the collection for a collection offer, the one NFT for a single-NFT
offer.

best_offer.description: The terms of one loan; each NFT taken is a loan of its own.

floor_price.description: The collection's floor; null when nothing is listed.

fundable_count.description: How many of those NFTs the offer can still fund now, one loan each at the shown principal: the smallest of the NFT count, the loans its remaining capacity covers and the loans the lender's balance and allowance cover. The lender's funds are shared with their other offers, so another borrower can take them first; a balance or allowance GONDI has not read does not limit the count.
fundable_count.title: Fundable Count

BorrowingOpportunity.title: BorrowingOpportunity

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

holdings_count.description: NFTs the wallet holds outside a loan, in its wallet, stash or vaults.
holdings_count.title: Holdings Count

holdings_read.description: How many of them were read for offers, at most 500.
holdings_read.title: Holdings Read

opportunities.description: The offers on the read NFTs, ranked, each with the NFTs it is the best offer on; empty when no lender offers on any.
opportunities.title: Opportunities

wallet_address.description: The wallet the NFTs belong to.
wallet_address.title: Wallet Address

wallet_name.description: The name the address was resolved from; null when the call passed an address.
wallet_name.title: Wallet Name
